titre: La flotte mondiale à équiper s'élargit
sous_titre: Nombre d'appareils en service, début 2026 et début 2036

Flotte commerciale 2026.texte: As of early 2026, the global commercial in-service aircraft fleet (excluding Russia) totaled about 30,000 aircraft.

Flotte commerciale 2036.texte: By the end of our forecast period, we expect the fleet to reach roughly 41,000 aircraft

Flotte militaire 2026.texte: increasing to 50,700 aircraft at the beginning of 2036 from 44,700 at the beginning of this year

Flotte militaire 2036.texte: we predict a 13.4% expansion in the fleet over the next decade, increasing to 50,700 aircraft
